title: "Mullagh Medal on debut" - Scott Boland press conference | AUS vs ENG - Third Ashes Test, Melbourne
quote_text:
Scott Boland, the second Indigenous man to play Test cricket for Australia, took 6-7 in the second innings in a player of the match performance that earned him the second ever Mullagh Medal. Australia won the match to take a 3-0 lead in the Vodafone men's Ashes Series and retain the Ashes.
